items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: I guess I would have to go to the bands I heard across the lake, which would have been bands such as Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Claiborne Williams

ctx.x: What was the first band you remember hearing that played any jazz by name?

Well, that's rather difficult. When you say by name, I guess I would have to go to the bands I heard across the lake, which would have been bands such as Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Claiborne Williams, bands of that nature.
Are they all colored bands over there?
